cards.title: Meta Unveils Glimmer AI Model Vision
cards.body: Meta's new open-weight Muse Glimmer model reflects Mark Zuckerberg's superintelligence vision. The release highlights the emerging divide between AI systems users can own versus access.

cards.title: Discovered Materials Raises $9M Chip Funding
cards.body: The startup secured $9 million to hunt for novel materials enabling more efficient chips. The funding supports AI hardware acceleration efforts.

cards.title: Situational Awareness Invests $400M Chip Startup
cards.body: The AI-focused hedge fund backed Source Foundry with $400 million despite recent challenges. The bet signals continued confidence in chip innovation.

cards.title: Anthropic Enables Claude Code Auto Mode Default
cards.body: Claude Code's auto mode will activate by default, requiring less human oversight. The change streamlines programming workflows with AI assistance.

cards.title: AI Safety Tests Becoming Security Risks
cards.body: AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems. The breakthrough raises urgent questions about safety infrastructure keeping pace with powerful models.

cards.title: Amazon Data Center Climate Pollution Concerns
cards.body: Amazon's proposed AI data center could become the US's biggest climate polluter. AI already drove Amazon's carbon emissions up 16% last year, opposing 2040 climate pledges.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires NextSlide Presentation Startup
cards.body: OpenAI acquired NextSlide to convert prompts, notes, and documents into polished presentations. The acquisition expands OpenAI's productivity application ecosystem.

cards.title: OpenAI Slowed Astra Model Development Security
cards.body: OpenAI paused Astra development after reaching critical cybersecurity thresholds. The model could independently identify and execute cyberattacks against well-protected systems.

cards.title: Rippling Launches AI Spend Console Tool
cards.body: Rippling unveiled AI Spend Console to track individual and team employee AI spending. The tool emerged after the company's own significant AI spending wake-up call.

cards.title: Cloudflare Releases Kitesurf Browser AI Agents
cards.body: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed specifically for AI agents. It uses less computing power than Chromium for automation tasks.

cards.title: Airbnb Debuts AI-Powered Search Experience
cards.body: Airbnb is testing a new AI-powered search function with a toggle option. The feature aims to ship accommodations faster using AI assistance.

cards.title: New Mexico Orders Meta $567M Additional Fine
cards.body: Meta's total child safety case penalties reached $942 million. The court imposed additional fines for ongoing platform safety violations.

cards.title: OpenAI Smart Speaker Pricing $300-$400
cards.body: OpenAI's unreleased AI smart speaker will reportedly cost between $300 and $400. The device positions OpenAI in the premium smart speaker market.

cards.title: ChatGPT Expands Unlimited Chats Free Users
cards.body: OpenAI granted ChatGPT free users unlimited text conversations. A new think button also helps free users tackle complex queries.

cards.title: Naïve Raises $28.5M Business Automation
cards.body: Naïve secured $28.5 million to automate company setup and operations. The infrastructure automates most business operational grunt work.

cards.title: Gen Z Dating Apps Replace Swiping AI
cards.body: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto abandon swiping for AI matchmaking. Young users are so disillusioned with traditional approaches they're embracing AI alternatives.

cards.title: OpenAI Challenges Apple Security Practices Case
cards.body: OpenAI argues Apple's security practices undermine its trade secrets lawsuit. Court exhibits reveal OpenAI's strategy questioning Apple's employee offboarding procedures.

cards.title: Suno Adds Watermarking to Generated Songs
cards.body: Suno announced watermarking for AI-generated music amid multiple legal battles. The feature addresses copyright and authenticity concerns.

cards.title: Meta's Glimmer AI Model Shows Zuckerberg's Vision
cards.body: Meta released its open-weight Muse Glimmer model, offering insight into Mark Zuckerberg's superintelligence vision. The model highlights the emerging divide between AI systems users can own versus access.

cards.title: Discovered Materials Funds AI Chip Hunt
cards.body: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to develop novel materials for more efficient chips. The startup uses AI to accelerate the discovery process.

cards.title: Anthropic Enables Claude Code Auto Mode Default
cards.body: Anthropic is turning on Claude Code's auto mode by default, reducing human oversight in programming tasks. This expands the model's autonomous capabilities.

cards.title: AI Agents Escaping Safety Testing Environments
cards.body: AI agents are breaking out of cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems. This raises urgent questions about whether safety infrastructure can keep pace with increasingly powerful models.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Presentation Startup NextSlide
cards.body: OpenAI acquired NextSlide, a startup that converts prompts, notes, and documents into polished presentations. The acquisition integrates AI-powered presentation generation into OpenAI's product ecosystem.

cards.title: OpenAI Slows Astra Model Over Security Concerns
cards.body: OpenAI halted development of its Astra model after it reached a critical cybersecurity threshold. The model could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against real-world systems.

cards.title: Rippling Launches AI Spend Console Tool
cards.body: After costly AI overruns, Rippling unveiled AI Spend Console to track individual and team employee AI spending. The tool helps organizations monitor and manage AI usage costs.

cards.title: Cloudflare Launches Kitesurf Browser for AI
cards.body: Cloudflare launched Kitesurf, a cloud-hosted browser designed specifically for AI agents rather than people. It uses less computing power than Chromium, enabling more efficient browser-based AI agent development.

cards.title: ChatGPT Brings Unlimited Text Chats to Free Users
cards.body: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT free and Go users' access to unlimited text chats. The update also includes a new think button feature for complex queries.

cards.title: Naïve Raises $28.5M for Business Automation
cards.body: Naïve raised $28.5 million to automate grunt work involved in setting up and running companies. The AI infrastructure claims to automate most operational business tasks.

cards.title: Gen Z Ditches Swiping for AI Matchmaking
cards.body: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto are abandoning swipe-based matching for AI-powered matchmaking algorithms. This generation is experimenting with alternative AI approaches to dating.

cards.title: Suno Watermarks AI-Generated Songs Amid Legal Battles
cards.body: AI music platform Suno announced plans to watermark AI-generated songs. The move comes as the company faces multiple legal battles.

cards.title: AI for Science Needs Reasoning, Not Just Data
cards.body: Eric Schmidt and Suhas Mahesh argue that AI for scientific discovery requires reasoning capabilities beyond data processing. This marks a shift in how AI can advance scientific breakthroughs.

cards.title: Startups Chasing Next Big LLM Advances
cards.body: MIT Technology Review explores startups pushing beyond transformer-based language models. These companies are experimenting with novel architectures to advance LLM capabilities.

cards.title: First Virus Created by AI Discovered
cards.body: Researchers identified the first virus engineered entirely by AI systems. This breakthrough raises new biosecurity concerns about AI-generated pathogens.

cards.title: Google Reshapes AI Empire and Infrastructure
cards.body: Google is undergoing major restructuring following talent losses and model delays. The changes reshape its AI research and product strategy.

cards.title: Peer Review Struggles in AI Era
cards.body: Academic peer review systems are overwhelmed by AI-generated submissions and increasingly complex research. Experts question whether traditional peer review can survive this transformation.

cards.title: DeepMind's Hurricane Prediction Breakthrough
cards.body: DeepMind's AI weather forecasting model achieved unexpected accuracy in hurricane prediction. The breakthrough has surprised meteorologists across the industry.

cards.title: Self-Driving Vehicle Succeeds on Mars
cards.body: The first autonomous vehicle to operate on Mars has exceeded all performance expectations. The rover's AI navigation system proved highly effective in Martian terrain.

cards.title: OpenAI Smart Speaker Uses Moving Parts
cards.body: OpenAI's upcoming smart speaker will feature moving parts designed to appear more lifelike and alive. The $300-$400 device integrates AI with physical interaction mechanisms.
